column4: Pixel-art first-person sprite exactly like the hand and weapon sprites of a 1990s Build-engine game (Duke Nukem 3D, Blood, Redneck Rampage), matching the reference image EXACTLY in its pixel size, palette and shading. Seen from the player's own eyes looking straight DOWN at the ground: the player's own two legs from the knees down, in worn faded blue denim jeans, the jeans tucked into tall olive-green rubber wellington boots with dark soles and a little dried mud at the toes, standing side by side about a shoulder apart, the toes pointing UP the canvas (away from the viewer), the boots seen from above so their tops are nearer the viewer and the toes further away, both jean legs coming in from the bottom edge of the canvas. No ground drawn, nothing else in the picture. Chunky pixels, strong simple shading, low saturation, the legs touch the bottom edge of the canvas. Background must be flat solid pure magenta #FF00FF everywhere around the legs, no shadow, no text, no border, no watermark.
